description: The terminal toggle (xterm) keeps the selected tab and restores hardware-keyboard focus. Terminals render with xterm, and the desktop window also has a touch screen. The browser is a 1280x900 desktop window. "Press K on X" means: focus X with an eval calling X.focus(), then press K (for example "Control+Shift+D" is the key "D" with modifiers Control+Shift, and "Control+Backquote" is the key "`" with modifier Control). "The message input" is data-testid "message-input"; "the terminal input" is the element with role "textbox" and accessible name exactly "Terminal input" that is visible; "focused" means it is document.activeElement. "The selected view" is the one visible element with a data-terminal-id attribute. Perform the steps in order. 1. Navigate to /c/{{ID}} and wait for the message input to be enabled. 2. Press Control+Backquote on the message input: the terminal input should be focused, and there should be exactly 1 ".terminal-panel-tab-running". 3. Remember the selected view's data-terminal-id (in a window variable) as the first terminal's ID. 4. Click the button with accessible name exactly "New terminal": there should be exactly 2 ".terminal-panel-tab-running", and the terminal input should be focused. 5. Click the first ".terminal-panel-tab": the selected view's data-terminal-id should be the first terminal's ID. 6. Focus the message input (eval). 7. key_down Control, then key_down "`" (hold them): the terminal input should be focused, and the selected view's data-terminal-id should still be the first terminal's ID. 8. key_down "`" again while it is still held (an auto-repeat): ".terminal-panel" must not have the class "terminal-panel-minimized", and the terminal input must still be focused. 9. key_up "`", then key_up Control. 10. Press Control+Backquote on the terminal input: ".terminal-panel" should have the class "terminal-panel-minimized", and the message input should be focused. 11. Press Control+Backquote on the message input: the terminal input should be focused, the selected view's data-terminal-id should be the first terminal's ID, and there should be exactly 2 ".terminal-panel-tab-running".
